description: Combinatorial purged cross-validation of a search: choose the best trial on training days, score it on held-out blocks, with purge and embargo at the edges, for every choice of blocks, stitched into whole paths. Returns the spread of out-of-sample Sharpes against the in-sample one. Splits can run as shards on other machines and merge back. Paths share days and data, so their spread is not a confidence interval and they are not independent tests.

embargo_days.description: Training days dropped after each test block. Default 5.

groups.description: Blocks history is cut into. Default 10.

merge_files.description: Instead of running: shard files to merge into one result.

out_file.description: Write the shard as JSON here.

purge_days.description: Training days dropped before each test block: at least the horizon the trials' returns look ahead over. Default 5.

returns_file.description: CSV: a date column and one column of daily returns per trial (breadth_book's out_file, say). At least two trials.

shard.description: Run only splits s with s mod of = index, to spread the work over machines.

test_groups.description: Blocks in each test set. Default 2.

name: cpcv
title: Combinatorial purged cross-validation
